name: A colleague describes their own achievement; the user only reacts

competencies.name: Problem Solving
competencies.description: Breaks a problem down and resolves it

reads.title: #platform — Acme Workspace
reads.text:
Tomas Lindqvist 16:20 Finished the Kubernetes migration. I moved every service to the new cluster, wrote the autoscaling policies, and cut node costs by a third by right-sizing the pools. The tricky part was draining stateful workloads without downtime, which I solved with a staged rollout and pod disruption budgets.
Sardor 16:24 nice work, congrats
Tomas Lindqvist 16:25 thanks! writeup is in the wiki if anyone wants the details
Sardor 16:26 will read it tomorrow

gate.activity_summary: Read a colleague's update about a migration and congratulated them.
